Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacterial infection often spread by splashing water and contaminated tools.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.solution: Remove infected leaves, avoid overhead watering, and sanitize tools.

Pepper__bell___healthy.cause: Healthy plant with no visible disease symptoms.
Pepper__bell___healthy.solution: Maintain proper watering, nutrition, and sunlight.

Potato___Early_blight.cause: Fungal disease favored by warm, humid conditions.
Potato___Early_blight.solution: Remove infected foliage and rotate crops yearly.

Potato___Late_blight.cause: Oomycete infection that spreads quickly in cool, wet weather.
Potato___Late_blight.solution: Remove infected plants and improve field drainage.

Potato___healthy.cause: Healthy plant with no visible disease symptoms.

Tomato_Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacterial infection spread through splashing water and tools.
Tomato_Bacterial_spot.solution: Prune infected leaves, avoid overhead irrigation, and disinfect tools.

Tomato_Early_blight.cause: Fungal disease caused by Alternaria species.
Tomato_Early_blight.solution: Remove infected leaves and mulch to reduce soil splash.

Tomato_Late_blight.cause: Oomycete infection thriving in cool, moist conditions.
Tomato_Late_blight.solution: Remove infected plants and increase airflow.
Tomato_Late_blight.recommended_medicine: Mancozeb or other late blight fungicides.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.cause: Fungal disease favored by high humidity and poor airflow.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.solution: Increase ventilation and remove affected leaves.

Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.cause: Fungal infection spread by rain splash and wet leaves.
Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.solution: Remove affected leaves and avoid overhead watering.

Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.cause: Mite infestation often due to hot, dry conditions.
Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.solution: Increase humidity and spray leaves with water.

Tomato__Target_Spot.cause: Fungal disease associated with warm, humid environments.
Tomato__Target_Spot.solution: Remove infected leaves and improve airflow.
